question_evidence_quote: spent $20 from the other half on groceries
observed_error: Step 3 identifies the remaining half-income minus $20 as the amount spent.
violated_condition: Groceries cost $20; I/2 - 20 is the remaining money and must equal $100.
error_description: Step 3 labels I/2 - 20 as the amount spent on groceries, although the grocery expense is $20. That expression represents the money remaining after the donation and grocery purchase. The subsequent equation subtracts this remainder from total income instead of setting it equal to the stated $100 left.
